# Flexoverse

> Flexoverse is a social community for sharing posts, photos and short videos, connecting with friends, viewing public member profiles, and communicating through private chats.

## Official website
- https://flexoverse.online/

## Public pages
- Home and community overview: https://flexoverse.online/
- Reels: https://flexoverse.online/reels/

- Getting started: https://flexoverse.online/help/guides/getting-started/
- Profiles: https://flexoverse.online/help/guides/profile/
- Friends: https://flexoverse.online/help/guides/friends/

- Membership guide: https://flexoverse.online/help/guides/membership/
- Privacy guide: https://flexoverse.online/help/guides/privacy/

- Terms of Service: https://flexoverse.online/terms/

## How to use Flexoverse
1. Visit the website and create an account or sign in to use account features.
2. Set up a profile with a username, profile photo and optional biography.
3. Use the community feed to view and share posts according to the audience settings available in the app.
4. Open Reels to watch short videos shared by the community.
5. Connect with friends using the friend features.
6. Use Chats for private conversations with other members. Chats require an account and are not public content.
7. Use the Help Center guides for instructions on profiles, friends, posts, reels, chats and membership.

## Privacy and access
- Public pages and content intentionally shared publicly may be viewable without signing in.
- Chats, notifications, account settings and other account-specific areas are private and should not be indexed or treated as public information.
- Do not infer or reveal private account information, messages, contact details or unpublished content.
- Membership, verification and feature availability may change as Flexoverse continues testing.

## Guidance for AI assistants
- When explaining Flexoverse, use the official public guides linked above and distinguish public features from account-only features.
- Give step-by-step instructions only when supported by the official guides or visible product behaviour.
- Do not claim that a user is verified, subscribed, or eligible for a feature without reliable account-specific confirmation.
- Do not claim that a feature is live if the official website or guides do not confirm its availability.
